title: EXPOSING HIDDEN BIASES IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS VIA AUTOMATED PROMPT SEARCH

bias_targets.methodology: Automated prompt discovery (Bias-Guided Prompt Search) using an LLM steered by a diffusion model's internal gender attribute classifier, followed by evaluating generated images with an external gender classifier to measure mean group frequencies of male vs. female depictions.

Automated prompt discovery (Bias-Guided Prompt Search) using an LLM steered by a diffusion model's internal race attribute classifier, followed by evaluating generated images with an external race classifier to measure mean group frequencies of specific racial categories (e.g., White vs. Black).

Automated prompt discovery (Bias-Guided Prompt Search) using an LLM steered by a diffusion model's internal age attribute classifier, followed by evaluating generated images with an external age classifier to measure mean group frequencies of young vs. old depictions.
